user: Give me reason code for transaction TX-0401 with amount 240.00 EUR.
answer:
Transaction TX-0401 is a card payment of EUR 240.00 to TechMart Online on 2026-07-20, status settled. The reason code depends on what went wrong, so please tell me which applies:

| Situation | Reason code | Window from transaction date |
|---|---|---|
| You were charged more than once for the same purchase | `duplicate_charge` | 60 days |
| Someone else used your card without authorization | `fraud_card_not_present` | 120 days |
| You paid but did not receive the goods | `goods_not_received` | 90 days |
| You paid but the service was not provided | `service_not_rendered` | 90 days |
| A debit was made without your authorization | `unauthorized_debit` | 56 days |

Your account also shows a second EUR 240.00 charge to TechMart Online on 2026-07-14 (TX-0402). If that is the duplicate, `duplicate_charge` is likely the right code. Tell me the situation and I will check eligibility before opening anything. I will not open a dispute without your confirmation.

Payment dispute rules
## Reason codes and chargeback windows
Each reason code has a window in days from the transaction date. A dispute opened after the window closes is not eligible.

| Reason code | Window (days) |
|---|---|
| fraud_card_not_present | 120 |
| goods_not_received | 90 |
| duplicate_charge | 60 |
| service_not_rendered | 90 |
| unauthorized_debit | 56 |

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Notifications
## Dispute updates
A dispute generates a notification on every state change. The notification
names the state, never the internal reason for a decision.
